build: Three TeX passes in each of two clean build directories; PDFs byte-identical on the recorded installation.
layout: Separate cover and contents pages; all bibliography entries on one page; no clipping, overlapping text, unreadable symbols, or overfull TeX boxes.
mathematical_review: Source-model algebra, probability proof, monotone inverse and arithmetic non-D-finiteness deduction independently reviewed; final mathematical transcription checked against those arguments.
scope: Review and exact finite validation are supplementary evidence. The asymptotic probability argument is in the article and is not certified by finite numerical testing.
text_review: No unresolved cross-references or citations; no private working paths or review-note filenames in extracted PDF text.
visual_review: All 18 rendered pages inspected, including full-size equations, table, cover, contents and references. Final cover spacing re-rendered and inspected after correction.
